_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'Starting with a focus on PC graphics, NVIDIA invented the GPU to solve some of the most complex problems in computer science. We have extended our emphasis in recent years to the revolutionary field of artificial intelligence, or AI.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change and evolving industry standards.' Its current competitors include 'suppliers of or licensors of discrete and integrated GPUs and accelerated computing processing solutions, including chipsets that incorporate 3D graphics functionality as part of their existing solutions, such as Advanced Micro Devices, or AMD, ARM Holdings plc, Imagination Technologies Group plc, Intel Corporation, or Intel, and Xilinx, Inc.' (FY2017 10-K); CYCLICAL kept although the 10-K no longer calls the business cyclical (the BKR FY2015 rule; the class label only); the 10-K names AI as the field NVIDIA has extended its emphasis to, a market it serves rather than a substitute for its products, so no theme in taxonomy_eras.json applies (the FY2013 10-K's cloud reading), and GPUs integrated into other processors stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -17.8%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +35.8%/yr (Q2 FY18 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +35.8%/yr (FY08-FY17 ex-FY09 ex-FY10 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +51.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2017-07-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (85.0% downside to Bear $24.71 / -25.0% upside to Bull $123.24) | Adj composite 2.30 vs market 3.77: gap -1.47 [OVERVALUED] | +326% above the EPP floor $38.55 (15x FY18E $2.57) | Conservative 2-yr case: -46.1% total (-23.1%/yr) | At 64.0x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $217.41 sits above the BULL case; revenue +48.4% YoY in Q1 FY18, forward revenues +33.8-39.3% (Q2 FY18 revenue guide (Q1 FY18 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
